name: building-blocks-navigation-atoms
title: Navigation Atoms
description: Compact Tailwind navigation primitives for breadcrumb links, tab triggers, pager dots, menu rows, and side-nav entries.
useWhen: Compact Tailwind navigation primitives for breadcrumb links, tab triggers, pager dots, menu rows, and side-nav entries.
avoidWhen: Avoid navigation atoms when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Navigation Atoms uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
